remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946" [note of backing inscription]. Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: This was in O'Keeffe exhibition at Anderson Gals, Jan.–Feb. 1923. . . . Therefore I am dating this picture ab. 1922." Backing inscription dates 1922 and 1927. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1922. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1922. Dated 1922 on basis on inclusion in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 18. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
